name: The cabin, ground floor
origin: floor centre; +y toward the north wall and its shelf units, the front door to the porch on the -y wall, the back hall and cellar trapdoor at the -x end, the kitchen through the -x wall

a1_cabin_arrival.note: Arrival by day: warm dusty sun, cedar. Mabel and Ruth, the shelves (look, never move), the Laugh prompt, then I1 at 3:30. Write your name in the guestbook; pages under it and in the game-box lid.

interactions.verb: Take the page under the guestbook
Take the page in the lid

a3_smell.note: Midday. Jamie lifts the rabbit off a chair: 'this thing smells weird.' Hold to lean in and smell; the screen's edges warm. Incident I3.

interactions.verb: Go out to the creek with Lila and Dani

a4_wrong_places.note: Grey morning. The toys where we hadn't left them; the pegs moved on the board. The 40-second argument, incident I8; a page behind the frame of Mabel's sampler.

a5_cabin_turns.note: The cabin turns: lights flicker at 2 Hz, the toys lunge. Run; every exit has toys in it; the only open way is down the back hall to the cellar trapdoor. You cannot be caught, only steered.

b6_waking.note: Black; 'Warmth. / Pressure. / Then light.' Morning on the shelf, blurred edges. Across: the four friends with button eyes on the east unit. The Still tutorial: Ruth's voice, the pulse, a clock.

b6_keepers_visit.note: Morning. Mabel and Ruth with a lint brush: 'Oh, they turned out lovely.' Being handled; hold Still. Ruth's whisper about the hunger.

b7_arrivals.note: Afternoon into evening. 'Car doors. / Laughter. / Footsteps on the porch.' The three you will hunt unpack in front of you; one reads the guestbook aloud. Release when the room is empty.

b7_jamie_falls.note: Evening. Jamie falls; a guest laughs and puts him on the couch; his head twitches. 'Did you see that?'

b8_breaking_point.note: Night, 'too quiet'. Dark but for the friends' glows on the east unit. Lila climbs down: 'She didn't want to.' The view flattens into the dollhouse.

c9_new_guests.note: Day, rewound: the same three step inside and you watch them as what you are. Wes pokes your arm; Ana moves Lila to another shelf. Learn who keeps score, who sleeps with a lamp, who talks to toys.

c10_hold_shelf.note: Night one, refused: hold Still on the shelf while the others play Sound; their sounds come from upstairs. Hunger rises unfed.

c11_toy_floor.note: Day two, daylight, guests awake: 'we changed positions.' Toy-floor camera; pick one of six spots and reach it unseen. Mid-morning the hike leaves one guest on the porch; the board waits on the table.

c11_hold_shelf.note: Day two, refused: hold Still while the others change positions around the guests.

c12_hold_shelf.note: Night two, refused: 'the warmth inside us was unbearable.' Hold Still; the shelf is warmer than the dark room around it.

c13_flight.note: Morning: the group leaves before the seal. Bags, car doors, the engine leaving; the shelf faces the window. Ana looks back.

c13_seal.note: 06:00, too warm. 'The door wouldn't open. / The windows wouldn't budge.' The rattling handle, a chair dragged; the shelf faces the door. Jamie falls off the couch.

c14_hold_shelf.note: The Chase, refused: 'alive warm' amber haze; screams and running from the hall while you hold the shelf.

c14_chase_cabin.note: Night, amber haze growing toward red. Toy floor plus gestures: Twitch, Tilt, Step. Herd the guests down the back hall to the basement door; 'The trapdoor opened on its own.'

e_cycle_shelf.note: The Cycle, dawn: car doors, laughter. 'I don't fight it anymore.' Locked on the shelf.

e_empty_toy.note: The Empty Toy, grey: the others leave the shelf to hunt without you. Awake and still.
